name: VulnCheck Knowledge Base / Glossary
description: VulnCheck Exploit Intelligence 101 — a glossary of ~42 exploit-intelligence-specific terms (active C2 servers, exploit kits, ransomware-related terms, attacker infrastructure components). Tightly scoped to vulnerability and threat-intelligence vocabulary.
relationToCloudSecurity: Indirect — exploit/threat-intel terms apply to cloud workloads but the source's emphasis is the attacker side of the equation.
relationToAISecurity: Minimal — pre-AI threat-intelligence vocabulary; no AI-specific entries.
